text:
Priya (Finance): Postmortem action check-in: we need single owners + deadlines for three items: 1) produce corrected token counts (backfill), 2) invoice corrections to AcmeCorp & NovaApps, 3) permanent telemetry + recurrence detection. Reply with name + ETA.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Ill take the corrected counts/backfill. Need read access to raw ingress chunk files and the tokenizer map. Plan: dry-run tonight, apply/CSV by Thu EOD. Will post `deltas_acme_nova.csv` to s3 when ready.

Maya (Billing): I will own the invoice adjustments and the customer-facing credit notes. Need Ashwin's CSV by Fri 10:00 PT to prepare legal-safe language and issue credits before month-end.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Ill own telemetry and the runbook. Action: add an ingestion-lag alert (threshold 5m for high-volume regions), create a recurrence-detection job that checks for repeated 4xx/5xx spikes, and add the pre-apply sanity gate for deltas >4%. PR by Thu.

Leo (Platform): Short-term infra mitigation: bump metering-api min-replicas=3, add a circuit to shed bursts to Kafka, and harden autoscaler cooldowns. Ill open a PR today and schedule a rolling update during low traffic.

LedgerBot: Ticket FI-8233 created: "Token-count backfill + invoices (AcmeCorp, NovaApps)" assigned to Maya (Billing).

Priya (Finance): For customer comms: keep it brief, include calculation appendix and contact for questions. Ill draft and share with Legal. Target draft by Fri 09:00 PT.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Dry-run done. Uploaded s3://redwood-metering/deltas/1910023456-dryrun.csv. A few accounts show 6-12% deltas; flagging AcmeCorp & NovaApps for manual review before apply.

Sam (Eng-SRE): I'll schedule the maintenance window Fri 01:00-02:00 UTC for the apply and will be present to rollback if anomalies appear. Also adding dashboard panel for per-customer delta trend.

Maya (Billing): Early estimate: combined credit ~ $9.1k. Holding final numbers until Ashwins apply csv.

Priya (Finance): Action recap for the tracker: Ashwin = backfill + final CSV (Thu EOD apply), Maya = invoice corrections + comms (Fri COB), Sam = telemetry/runbook + dashboard (PR Thu), Leo = infra PR + rolling update (PR today). Ill update the postmortem doc and schedule a 10-min exec sync after final numbers.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Applying backfill in maintenance window now. Will post `1910023456-deltas.csv` when complete.

LedgerBot: Reminder set: FI-8233 check-in in 48h.

Maya (Billing): Thanks all. Ping me if you want a draft credit memo or invoice preview attachment.
